# Python dependencies for the WoundWatch Azure Functions.
azure-functions
requests
azure-storage-blob

# Firebase / Firestore.
# IMPORTANT: pin the Firebase + Google stack to Protobuf 4.25-generated code.
# The Azure Functions Python host bundles Protobuf runtime 5.29.x, and it
# refuses to load code generated with a NEWER protoc (the unpinned firebase-admin
# pulls Protobuf 6.x gencode -> VersionError at import, crashing every Firestore
# function). Protobuf 4.25 gencode loads fine under the host's 5.29 runtime.
firebase-admin==6.5.0
google-cloud-firestore==2.16.1
googleapis-common-protos==1.63.2
protobuf==4.25.5
